objective: Test whether checkpoint-16 greedy first-divergence repair improves the open native scene benchmark without full-sequence gold CE or synthetic teacher-forced negatives.

training_data.exclusion_rule: Exclude every row used by checkpoint 16, robust seeds 17/29/43, checkpoint-16 residual seeds 71/89/107, and precision-unlikelihood seed 131.
training_data.selection_rule: Hash-sort untouched eligible rows by SHA-256('rwkv-ms-native-scene-c16-onpolicy-repair-v1:149:' + row SHA-256) and take the first 96.

greedy_mining.timing: Generate all 96 selected rows from frozen checkpoint 16 before the first optimizer update.
greedy_mining.actionable_row: The recovered prediction must contain at least one boundary absent from gold and must have a concrete first token divergence from the gold generated continuation.
greedy_mining.repair_prefix: The exact checkpoint-16 generated token prefix before the first divergence.
greedy_mining.correct_token: The gold continuation token at the first divergence.
greedy_mining.wrong_token: The checkpoint-16 greedy token at the first divergence.
greedy_mining.invalid_or_non_false_positive_outputs: Audit and skip without a gradient.

intervention.loss: For each actionable row, softplus(wrong_logit - correct_logit + 0.5) at only the first greedy divergence, conditioned on the exact generated prefix.
intervention.post_step_proximal_rule: After each AdamW step, replace theta by checkpoint16 + 0.99 * (theta - checkpoint16).

materialization.rule: Use the single locked update-6 endpoint unchanged.

evaluation.source: The 220 already-open publisher-TRAIN-derived scene fit rows left after the locked 64-row contrast probe.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push all outcomes. Never inspect publisher validation predictions, publisher test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.
